steps.step_name: Student opens a ticket in Sipac
CRA opens the process in Sipac
Notify student about any pending issues via email
Enter the process in the academic system
Send notification of approval by email

exceptions.what_goes_wrong: Missing documents, incomplete information, or discrepancies in the student's submission
exceptions.impact: Occurs in about 25% of cases; requires follow-up and can delay the process by anywhere from a day or two to a week or more depending on student response time
exceptions.recovery: Notify the student via email to request the necessary documents; proceed once resubmissions are received

exceptions.impact: Happens about once every couple of weeks; slows ticket resolution by a day or two
exceptions.recovery: Maintain open lines of communication and set clear expectations with other departments

exceptions.what_goes_wrong: Manual duplicate data entry between Sipac and the academic system can introduce errors
exceptions.impact: Feels like wasted time and carries a risk of manual data-entry errors
exceptions.recovery: Double-check entries as part of the process
